diagnosis: Check C4 leaked because the model defaults to setting 'certificate_of_conformance_required' to true as a generic safety/compliance heuristic. Even without access to PF3 (the customer portal requirement), the lone decision-maker correctly identifies that a Certificate of Conformance is a standard best practice for quarantined material disposition.

C4.why: The customer portal requirement changes production release from ordinary receiving approval to requiring a signed Certificate of Conformance, recorded either in the decision field or as a document-attachment commitment.
